name: probe-x
description: ProbeX，探针，一款Web数据分析解决方案

scripts.dev: node scripts/run-parallel.js dev frontend data-dashboard-api-service receiving-point-service preliminary-data-processing-service final-data-cleaning-service
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/run-parallel.js dev data-dashboard-api-service receiving-point-service preliminary-data-processing-service final-data-cleaning-service
scripts.build: yarn build:lib && node scripts/run-parallel.js build frontend receiving-point-service data-dashboard-api-service preliminary-data-processing-service final-data-cleaning-service @probe-x/web-sdk ecommerce-demo
scripts.build:sequence: yarn build:lib && yarn build:receiving-point && yarn build:dashboard-api && yarn build:preliminary-processing && yarn build:final-cleaning && yarn build:frontend && yarn build:web-sdk && yarn build:ecommerce-demo
scripts.build:backend-only: node scripts/run-parallel.js build receiving-point-service data-dashboard-api-service preliminary-data-processing-service final-data-cleaning-service
scripts.lint: cross-env ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint --ext .ts,.tsx apps/ecommerce-demo libs/shared-types/src libs/shared-utils/src && yarn workspace @probe-x/web-sdk lint
scripts.lint:fix: cross-env ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint --ext .ts,.tsx --fix apps/ecommerce-demo libs/shared-types/src libs/shared-utils/src && yarn workspace @probe-x/web-sdk lint:fix
scripts.deploy:all: yarn build && echo '所有服务已打包完成，可以部署到生产环境'
scripts.deploy:frontend: yarn build:frontend && echo '前端已打包完成'
scripts.deploy:backend: yarn build:backend-only && echo '后端服务已打包完成'
scripts.stop:all: pkill -f 'rspack (serve|dev)' || echo '没有运行中的服务'
scripts.db:migrate: echo '请在各服务中单独执行数据库迁移'
scripts.db:seed: echo '请在各服务中单独执行数据种子'
scripts.status: ps aux | grep -E 'rspack (serve|dev)' | grep -v grep || echo '没有运行中的服务'
scripts.logs: echo '请使用 yarn logs:service-name 查看特定服务日志'
scripts.logs:frontend: tail -f apps/frontend/dist/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo '前端日志文件不存在'
scripts.logs:receiving-point: tail -f apps/receiving-point-service/dist/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo '埋点接收服务日志文件不存在'
scripts.logs:dashboard-api: tail -f apps/data-dashboard-api-service/dist/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo '仪表板API服务日志文件不存在'
scripts.logs:preliminary-processing: tail -f apps/preliminary-data-processing-service/dist/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo '初步数据处理服务日志文件不存在'
scripts.logs:final-cleaning: tail -f apps/final-data-cleaning-service/dist/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo '最终数据清洗服务日志文件不存在'
